purpose: Define reusable Expose Elements as explicit UI primitive definitions/instances whose identity remains separate from represented domain resources, operations and layout placement.

topics.name: Expose Element Identity
topics.purpose: Define reusable Expose Elements as explicit UI primitive definitions/instances whose identity remains separate from represented domain resources, operations and layout placement.

semantics.identity_rule: Every machine-significant Element definition/type has an explicit identity.
semantics.instance_rule: Rendered Element instance identity is separate from Element type/definition identity.
semantics.binding_rule: Represented resource/value/operation refs are explicit bindings.
semantics.layout_rule: Placement/nesting is presentation structure and never semantic ownership by itself.
semantics.style_rule: Visual style is resolved through canonical style/token semantics rather than duplicated domain definitions.
semantics.label_rule: Human-facing labels resolve through localization identities/context.
semantics.authority_rule: Element existence, visibility, focus or apparent enabled state never grants access or execution authority.

invariants.rule: Expose Elements are reusable human-interface primitives that project or invoke explicitly bound semantics; visual form, nesting, focus, color, position or enabled-looking state never creates ownership, authority or domain meaning.

hard_gates.condition: element id replaces represented resource identity
